name: Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
summary: Public university on Madrid's Getafe and Leganés campuses; 20 bachelor's you can take fully in English, at public fees near €1,000–1,250 a year.

ib.text: IB via UNEDasiss: your IB becomes a grade out of 10, and two weighted subjects (IB grades on the credential or PCE tests) add up to 4. Prove B2 English during year 1.

lastYear.text: pre-enrolment 5–26 June; foreign systems to 6 July

programmes.name: Bachelor in Biomedical Sciences
programmes.about: The biology of health and disease from molecules to whole systems, aimed at better prevention, diagnosis and treatment; taught at the School of Health Sciences.
programmes.overview: The first year covers cell biology, biophysics, chemistry, biostatistics, microbiology, molecular biology, biochemistry, genetics and histology, followed by anatomy, physiology, immunology, biotechnology and toxicology, and later epidemiology, general pathology, experimental models and pathology of cancer, infectious and cardiovascular disease. Dedicated laboratory courses run in the third and fourth years, external internships are available, and a research-based bachelor thesis closes the degree. You can follow a voluntary itinerary in microbiology, cardiology or oncology. Graduates work as laboratory technicians, biomedical researchers, quality control specialists and diagnostic staff, or go on to master's study and research.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Neuroscience
programmes.about: The experimental and formal sciences of the nervous system, applied to pharmacology, clinical medicine and research into brain disease.
programmes.overview: The first year lays foundations in biophysics, chemistry, genetics, mathematics, biostatistics, biochemistry, immunology and neurobiology; then come neuroanatomy, cellular neurophysiology, cognition, laboratory techniques and programming, and later neurological and psychiatric disease, neuroimaging, brain-machine interfaces and neuropharmacology. Laboratory work runs throughout, internships can be done at research institutes, hospitals and pharmaceutical or technology companies, and a bachelor thesis closes the degree. Electives let you lean toward computational neuroscience, neurodegeneration, pain or toxicology. Graduates work as research scientists and healthcare technicians, or continue to postgraduate study.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor's Degree in Primary Education
programmes.about: A new primary-teacher degree built on practical training, with teaching in schools from the second year and an international outlook.
programmes.overview: The first year covers developmental and educational psychology, the theory and sociology of education, inclusive education and digital skills, and later years turn to teaching Spanish, mathematics, English, social and experimental sciences, physical education, music and arts. You are in schools from the second year on, with placements that grow longer each year, and a bachelor thesis closes the degree. Teaching is bilingual in English and Spanish, and you can follow a mention in English language teaching or in special educational needs. Graduates qualify as primary school teachers and can continue to a master's in secondary teacher training.
programmes.ib: Taught in Spanish and English groups; choose the English group at enrolment. UC3M may ask for Spanish B2 for a Spanish-taught or bilingual degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Administration
programmes.about: Business and public-organisation management for national and international careers, with a rigorous grounding in the core business disciplines.
programmes.overview: The first year covers economics, mathematics, accounting, statistics, law and communication, followed by macroeconomics, organisational behaviour, financial economics and commercial law, then marketing, financial management and strategy. The last year brings strategic and operations management, electives and a bachelor thesis, and external academic internships are available with a large network of companies. Electives let you lean toward financial accounting, general management or marketing management, and an English-language group runs on the Getafe campus. Graduates work as marketing managers, financial analysts, HR managers, auditors, consultants and logistics directors.
programmes.ib: Taught in Spanish and English groups; choose the English group at enrolment. UC3M may ask for Spanish B2 for a Spanish-taught or bilingual degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 (UNEDasiss grade plus up to 4 from weighted subjects). 2026 cut-off 10.996 at Colmenarejo.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Economics
programmes.about: Rigorous analysis of economic problems and of the likely effects of public and private policies, grounded in evidence and economic models.
programmes.overview: The first two years build the foundations in mathematics, statistics, microeconomics and macroeconomics, and the last two give you wide freedom in electives, including three optional intensification paths: microeconomics, macroeconomics, or quantitative techniques and applied economics. External internships are available through the university's company network, a bachelor thesis is required, and teaching is offered in both Spanish and English with exchanges through Erasmus. Faculty research feeds into the teaching. Graduates work in economic consulting, financial analysis, risk assessment, public administration and international organisations.
programmes.ib: Taught in Spanish and English groups; choose the English group at enrolment. UC3M may ask for Spanish B2 for a Spanish-taught or bilingual degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Finance and Accounting
programmes.about: Investment analysis and management, banking, auditing, consulting and financial management: valuing companies and managing their financial risks.
programmes.overview: The first year covers financial mathematics, business administration, economics, introductory accounting, statistics and law, then financial accounting, financial economics and derivatives, and later cost management, risk management, financial statement analysis, auditing and corporate governance, with electives such as sustainable finance and big data analytics. Professional internships with banks and audit firms are available, a bachelor thesis closes the degree, and teaching is bilingual in Spanish and English. Graduates work as financial analysts, risk managers, auditors, consultants and civil servants in regulatory bodies.
programmes.ib: Taught in Spanish and English groups; choose the English group at enrolment. UC3M may ask for Spanish B2 for a Spanish-taught or bilingual degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in International Studies
programmes.about: A multidisciplinary degree taught entirely in English: global governance, political economy, migration, conflict, democratisation and climate change.
programmes.overview: The first year covers micro- and macroeconomics, comparative politics, sociology, world politics, statistics and legal methods, followed by international political economy, public law, international organisations, security and conflict resolution, then human rights, international finance and policy evaluation. Electives let you focus on development cooperation, trade, geopolitics, democracy or security policy. A bachelor thesis closes the degree, external internships are possible, and exchanges run through Erasmus. Graduates work in multinational companies, international organisations, NGOs, think tanks, public administration, political consulting and investigative journalism.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Management and Technology
programmes.about: Business management on a solid technology base: ERP systems, big-data analysis and business programming alongside the management disciplines.
programmes.overview: Management and technology are taught together: the first year covers economics, mathematics, accounting, programming and IT basics, followed by databases, operations, digital business and statistics, then big data, AI in business, machine learning and strategy, and finally cybersecurity, financial management and a thesis. Electives let you focus on digital marketing, ERP systems, supply chain or innovation management, and students gain training in SAP applications. Internships are available through a large network of companies, and exchanges run through Erasmus. Graduates work as economists, business intelligence analysts, ICT specialists and management consultants.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Urban Sustainability Studies (joint with european universities)
programmes.city: Getafe and Leganés, plus YUFE partner universities
programmes.about: A joint three-year degree of the YUFE alliance on sustainable cities and rural areas, with at least two stays at partner universities.
programmes.overview: A three-year degree shared with partner universities in Belgium, the Netherlands, Finland, the United Kingdom, Poland and Croatia. The first year covers comparative sociology, economics, climate science, urban development, statistics, environmental technology and cultural geography; the next two years are built from three minors on topics such as urban health, sustainable business, smart cities, urban ecology and sustainable tourism, chosen across partner universities. You work in project-based Challenge Teams solving real sustainability problems, spend at least two periods at partner universities, and write a bachelor thesis. The degree leads to specialised master's programmes.
programmes.ib: Pre-apply on the YUFE website; UC3M's 15 places are allocated only on your admission grade through the Madrid pre-enrolment in July.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Dual Bachelor in International Studies and Business Administration
programmes.about: Two degrees taught entirely in English: business management and administration combined with multidisciplinary international studies.
programmes.overview: Taught in English over five and a half years, the dual degree starts with economics, mathematics, law, politics and introductory accounting, then moves to international trade, strategic management, marketing, financial management, international organisations, globalisation and security studies. Multidisciplinary seminars on international studies run alongside, you write a bachelor thesis for each degree, and electives include international security policy and sustainable finance. External internships are available at companies and organisations, and Erasmus exchanges are possible. Graduates work as marketing directors, export managers, financial analysts, or in business intelligence, public administration, NGOs, think tanks and diplomacy.

programmes.name: Dual Bachelor in International Studies and Economics
programmes.about: Two degrees taught entirely in English: economics combined with international studies, for careers with an international dimension.
programmes.overview: Taught in English on the Getafe campus over five and a half years, the dual degree starts with mathematics, economics, statistics, business administration and politics, then adds macroeconomics, microeconomic theory, econometrics and financial economics alongside public law, international political economy and trade. Later electives cover innovation, development, security policy and emerging countries, and you write a bachelor thesis for each degree. Programming and data analysis are built in, external internships are available, and Erasmus exchanges are possible. Graduates work as financial analysts, strategic consultants and tax inspectors, or in international organisations, NGOs, public administration and think tanks.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Aerospace Engineering
programmes.about: Design, manufacture and certification of aircraft, spacecraft, satellites, engines and air-navigation systems.
programmes.overview: After a first year of mathematics, physics, programming and chemistry, you study fluid mechanics, aerodynamics, propulsion, structures, materials, thermal engineering and flight mechanics, then advanced design and control. In the last years you specialise in aerospace vehicles (aircraft design, aeroelasticity, flight mechanics) or aerospace propulsion (turbomachinery, combustion, rocket motors). Classes are small and practical, with laboratory work, optional professional internships and a bachelor thesis. Graduates work in the design, manufacture, certification and maintenance of aircraft and spacecraft, and in air navigation systems.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Applied Mathematics
programmes.about: Mathematical theory with a clear focus on solving real problems through models in science, engineering and economics.
programmes.overview: The first year covers linear algebra, calculus, programming and digital skills, then differential equations, numerical methods, mechanics and probability, and later functional analysis, optimisation, game theory, stochastic calculus and mathematical biology. In the final year you choose among many electives, such as machine learning, cryptography, financial mathematics, biophysics, quantum physics and robotics, and write a bachelor thesis. Teaching is in English, internships are available and Erasmus exchanges are possible. Graduates enter technology and software companies, financial institutions, AI, aerospace, research centres, biotechnology and data consulting.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Artificial Intelligence
programmes.about: Mathematics, statistics and computer science combined to build systems that learn, reason and solve problems on their own.
programmes.overview: The first year covers programming, linear algebra, calculus, discrete mathematics, logic, probability and statistics, then data structures, automata and formal languages, databases and early machine learning, and later deep learning, knowledge-based systems, cloud computing, generative AI, ethics and security. The last year brings computer vision, robotics, natural language processing, a capstone AI project and a bachelor thesis, with electives from quantum computing to AI in healthcare. Part-time professionals teach on the degree, internships are possible, and English-taught teaching is offered on the Leganes campus. Graduates work as AI engineers, machine learning specialists and research scientists.
programmes.ib: Taught in Spanish and English groups; choose the English group at enrolment. UC3M may ask for Spanish B2 for a Spanish-taught or bilingual degree.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14 (UNEDasiss grade plus up to 4 from weighted subjects). 2026 cut-off 10.766 at Colmenarejo.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Biomedical Engineering
programmes.about: Engineering for medicine: new medical technologies, instrumentation and imaging, tissue engineering and regenerative medicine.
programmes.overview: The first year covers mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology and programming with an introduction to bioengineering, followed by biochemistry, electronics, statistics, control engineering and fluid mechanics in biomedicine, and later medical instrumentation, physiology, robotics, tissue engineering, biomaterials and medical image processing. Strong laboratory work, internships in hospitals, companies and research centres, and a bachelor thesis feature, and you can concentrate on tissue engineering, biomedical imaging, or instrumentation and medical devices. Graduates work in pharmaceutical and biotech firms, hospitals, consulting and research on medical devices, diagnostics and new therapies.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Data Science and Engineering
programmes.credential: Bachelor in Data Science and Engineering
programmes.about: Extracting useful information from large data sets for business, health, translation, recommendation and decision systems.
programmes.overview: Mathematics, statistics, computer science and telecommunications are combined, starting with linear algebra, calculus, programming, probability and data analysis, then statistical learning, databases, machine learning, signal processing and cybersecurity, and later deep learning, optimisation, Bayesian analysis and web and mobile development. A data science project, hands-on labs, optional internships and a bachelor thesis feature, and electives cover natural language processing, computer vision, healthcare, bioinformatics and robotics. Graduates work as data scientists, data engineers and machine learning engineers in finance, healthcare, automotive, retail and technology.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Energy Engineering
programmes.about: Renewable and conventional energy, energy efficiency and demand management for a fast-changing energy industry.
programmes.overview: The first year covers linear algebra, calculus, physics, programming and communication, then industrial automation, electrical fundamentals, thermal engineering and fluid mechanics, followed by wind and solar energy, power generation, transmission and energy economics, and finally nuclear energy and demand management. The degree is taught in English with well-equipped laboratories, internships with energy companies and a bachelor thesis, and electives include energy in buildings, transport and smart grids. Graduates work on sizing thermal and renewable generation, energy efficiency, auditing and energy market analysis.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Engineering Physics
programmes.about: Modern physics, chemistry and biology applied to engineering, for research centres and technology companies building future technologies.
programmes.overview: The first year covers mathematics, physics, chemistry, programming and statistics, then quantum physics, mechanics and relativity, electromagnetism, optics and materials science, followed by statistical physics, fluid mechanics, electronic engineering and instrumentation, and finally quantum computation, biomaterials and nanoelectronics. Lab practicals are held in small groups, internships are available and a bachelor thesis closes the degree. Electives range from quantum technologies, nanomaterials and plasma physics to renewable energy, robotics and control. Graduates work in research centres, biotechnology, quantum computing, nanotechnology, photonics and the space industry.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Mathematics and Computing
programmes.about: Applied mathematics where computation is central: designing algorithms and numerical methods to model and solve real problems.
programmes.overview: Mathematics and computer science are studied together, from linear algebra, calculus, discrete mathematics and programming, through numerical methods, complex analysis, cryptography, automata, algorithms and artificial intelligence, to differential equations, optimisation, databases and language processors. Final-year electives include machine learning, financial mathematics, parallel programming and stochastic processes, and a bachelor thesis closes the degree. Laboratory work runs throughout, external internships are available and exchanges run through Erasmus. Graduates work as quantitative analysts, software developers, scientific computing specialists, researchers and consultants.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Robotics Engineering
programmes.about: Complex technological problems from robot design to real-world deployment, across the broad range of robotics technologies.
programmes.overview: After mathematics, physics, programming and an introduction to robotics, you study electronics, control engineering, signals and systems, mechanics and industrial robotics, then sensors and actuators, machine learning, computer vision and robot programming, and finally human-robot interaction, collaborative and soft robotics, cybersecurity and ethics. Special laboratories, small-group practicals, robotics projects and optional internships form the practical side, with electives such as deep learning and biomedical robotics, and a bachelor thesis. Graduates work in industrial automation, robot manufacturing, aerospace, hospitals and research institutes, and engineering consultancies.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your admission grade out of 14: the UNEDasiss grade (out of 10) plus up to 4 points from two weighted subjects. 2026 cut-off shown.

notes: Early Admission (22 September 2025 to 10 April 2026 for 2026 entry) offers 8% of places to IB students not living in Spain, decided 90% on grades.
In the English groups you must prove B2 English during the first year; students from non-Spanish-speaking countries are guaranteed English-group places for two years.
One Madrid pre-enrolment lets you list up to 12 degrees, in order of preference, across the six public universities.
